title: Pinji language — Grokipedia
text: Pinji belongs to the Bantu B30 language group, also known as the Tsogo or Okani group, within the broader Niger-Congo phylum. It is classified as part of the Okani subgroup, which encompasses closely related varieties such as Okande, Ishogo, Ivea, Shibe, Micogo, Bafubi (or Bopovi), and Aduañgi.
